146309.title: Settings > Maintenance shows one schedule list; only Settings Service can reach it

146310.title: The first empty Maintenance screen prompts the first schedule; a schedule with no services cannot be saved

146311.title: New schedule opens an empty 'Untitled schedule' editor; it exists only from the first Save

146312.title: The schedule editor carries a name and services; Save is disabled until one service exists

146313.title: A schedule name cannot be blank or duplicated

146314.title: The service table shows Service / Interval / Canned Lines and is reorderable

146315.title: The schedule list: Active/Archived tabs, sortable columns, search, per-row menu; archived opens read-only

146316.title: Add service opens a blank form in a fixed order; the service has one name and it cannot be blank

146317.title: Calendar interval is always present and required; distance and engine hours are optional extra triggers

146318.title: Interval operator Every vs At; calendar At is a day-and-month picker

146319.title: The distance unit is 'mileage' in full and the meter unit is 'hours' in full

146320.title: Interval number fields accept whole numbers within caps only

146321.title: The service comes due at whichever trigger arrives first, stated once with no 'or'

146322.title: Months land on the same day; days drift; a missing anchor day falls on the month's last day

146323.title: Services also covered: a service names other services it covers, pre-filling their lines

146324.title: Is this a compliance inspection? is asked before the trigger and replaces it

146325.title: Compliance Type is required free text with examples; a type can be renamed but not deleted while referenced

146326.title: Compliance Term and Remind before expiry are in months; remind cannot exceed the term

146327.title: No certificate date on the Settings form; a compliance service is orange and needs a record to come due

146328.title: Add canned lines opens a searchable picker showing hours, not prices

146329.title: A service shows no value; the line count opens a hover card listing covered services then its lines

146330.title: Canned lines are optional; later edits and deletions in Settings flow through

146331.title: Reminder timing rows are in days, with three defaults, a protected due-date row and a five-row ceiling

146332.title: Reminder rows drive due-soon only (no email this release); compliance has none

146333.title: Editing a schedule is silent and never touches assets already enrolled

146334.title: Editing or removing a service asks for confirmation and never touches assets already enrolled

146335.title: An active schedule can be duplicated; the copy carries no enrolled assets

146336.title: Archiving deactivates a schedule and unenrols every asset; restoring puts none back

146337.title: Remove from schedule takes one asset off one schedule; history stays

146338.title: History survives removal and archiving; re-enrolling anchors from the last completion

146339.title: Enrolment opens the same modal from three places and is for one of the asset's customers

146340.title: The modal collects the schedule then one optional last-service date per service

146341.title: In the modal, compliance rows show the record or Add one, and meterless services show a needs-reading badge

146342.title: Bulk enrolment from the customer's Assets tab, one customer at a time

146343.title: The customer's Maintenance-notifications setting shows in enrolment and is a live toggle on the customer

146344.title: Notification setting: no bulk consent; it stands if enrolment is cancelled

146345.title: Enrolment never triggers a bulk send; the backlog appears on the worklist, not in email
